title: It's good, but maybe mine was bad.
text:
It's good, but maybe mine was bad.. So ultimately i think this product is worth it. The amount of space and effort you save to keep your floors clean doesn't compared to even a Swiffer style mop. It's so easy to use and convenient and cleans so well that my mom ended up getting one shortly after I did.

The reason i gave it 4 stars is because maybe two months ago, so that's 7 months of daily (multiple times a day) use, one of the spinners became loose so that when the weight of the mop was on both, one wouldnt spin. It was more of an incovenient fix than an impossible one. There's a screw in the very middle of each spinner that came loose. Once I tightened that, it was fixed. But then the spray didn't work..that one I couldn't figure out. A month after using a spray bottle with the mop, i decided to just get a steam mop; I didn't want to get this again and have bad luck again. But I don't regret buying it and my mom's still works great.

Bissell spinwave is also equipped with on-demand spray that allows you to dispense just the right amount of multi-surface solution onto your floors. In addition, swivel steering makes it easy to maneuver around and under furniture. Includes a 2-year limited. Surface type: Bare floors, sealed hard floors. Surface cleaning: Sealed hard floors.
